_說明: 首頁四種語言的文字。build.py 讀這份產生 <語言>/index.html。功能八格、截圖說明的順序四語要一致。 zh-Hant 的 auto 是自動記帳宣傳圖，排在「看看畫面」最前面（宣傳圖只有繁中，其他語言沒有這個鍵就只放 App 截圖）。

zh-Hant.description: 一隻羊毛氈兔兔，住在手機裡陪你記帳存錢。白天是午後手帳，晚上是下雨的床邊窗。沒有廣告、不收集資料。

兔兔的小房間
白天是午後手帳，晚上是下雨的床邊窗。

グループに参加

Pick a category, type the amount, done. It shows up on Home right away.
Cotton's room
A sunlit afternoon journal by day, a rainy window by night.
Budgets you can see
One ring shows what's left. Overspent categories turn red.
Saving like a stamp card
Every time you save, you get a stamp.
Budget together
Share a ledger with your partner or roommate and see who logged what.

Monthly recap
At the start of each month, see where last month's money went.

en.shotsSub: Real screens from the app. Swipe left for more.
trust: Open it and log. No ads, ever.

android.title: Android beta | Howausa
android.desc: Install the Howausa beta on your Android phone in three steps.
android.sub: Howausa for Android is in closed testing. Three steps and you're in.
steps: Join the tester group
Open the group page with the Google account on your phone and tap “Join group”.
Join group
Become a tester
Open the testing page and tap “Become a tester”.
Become a tester
No button yet? Google is still processing. Wait 5–15 minutes and refresh.
Download from Google Play
On the same page tap “Download it on Google Play”, or use the button below.
Open Google Play
No “Install” yet? Wait 5–15 minutes and open it again.
tips: Use the same Google account for all three steps — the one signed in to the Play Store on your phone.
If a page shows up blank, open it in Chrome and check the account in the top-right corner.
Google Drive sync in the beta is still rolling out, so some accounts can't sign in yet. Everything else works.
Questions or ideas? Tell us on Threads @yuzuki.tw.
